text: Truthmaker necessitarianism is the thesis that if an entity T is a truthmaker for a proposition p, then T's existence metaphysically necessitates the truth of p.
explanation: True. Necessitarianism (Armstrong) holds that truthmaking is a necessary relation: necessarily, if the truthmaker exists then the proposition is true, so there is no world containing T in which p is false. This is distinct from maximalism, which is the further claim that every truth has some truthmaker.
